marks.gloss_en: he did not return the ugly man's greeting, and said: Reika, how ugly that man is! are all your townsmen as ugly as you?
the man to the townsmen: if this is a rabbi, may there not be many like him in Israel -- he did such and such to me
the man: for your sakes I forgive him, provided he not be accustomed to do so
סבר לה כי הא דאמר רבי ינאי ... מנכין לו מזכיותיו -- a miracle done for him is deducted from his merits
אמר רב חנן: מאי קרא -- דכתיב קטנתי מכל החסדים ומכל האמת
the stam: Rav Adda holds in accordance with R' Yannai's dictum
מאי הוה עובדיה דרב אדא בר אהבה? כי הא דאתמר -- the deeds behind the great merit Rav relied on
the stam: Rav Adda's deeds [behind his great merit] are those he reported when asked how he lengthened his days
ולתיביה לעניים! -- let him give them to the poor
זמנין דסמכא דעתייהו ולא אתו למיזבן -- at times they would rely on it and not come to buy
ולשדייה לבהמה! -- let him throw them to animals
קסבר: מאכל אדם אין מאכילין לבהמה (= p_maachal_adam_libhema, attributed to Rav Huna)
every Sabbath-eve afternoon he sent a messenger to the market, bought all the vegetables left to the gardeners and threw them in the river
ולא ליזבניה כלל! -- then let him not buy them at all
נמצאת מכשילן לעתיד לבא -- you would be found to make them stumble in the future
the collapse of which they spoke is of sound [walls], not shaky ones -- those not fit to fall, not those fit to fall
it is needed for walls that fell because of their height
the shaky wall in Nehardea under which Rav and Shmuel would not pass, though it had stood in place thirteen years
Rav Huna brought Rav Adda bar Ahava into the shaky house and kept him in a halakhic discussion until the wine was removed; after they left the house fell
and I did not meditate [on Torah] in filthy alleys
Rafram: his youth I do not remember; his old age I remember
when he had a medicine he filled a jug with it, hung it on his doorpost and said: whoever wants, let him come and take
when he ate bread he opened his doors and said: whoever needs, let him come and eat
